name: CN_TP_RATE_TIER_SPLITS_ALL
description: This table stores the intermediate calculation results for rate dimensions using split option.

columns.name: RATE_TIER_SPLIT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of rate tier split.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: MEASURE_RESULT_ID
columns.description: When the record is related to the calculation of a performance measure, this columns contains the identifier of the related measure result.

columns.name: EARNING_ID
columns.description: When the record is related to the calculation of a plan component, this columns contains the identifier of the related earning.

columns.name: PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the period of the calculation result related to this record.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the sales rep of the calculation result related to this record.

columns.name: SRP_COMP_PLAN_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the sales rep and compensation plan association.

columns.name: PLAN_COMPONENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the plan component of the calculation result related to this record.

columns.name: FORMULA_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the formula of the calculation result related to this record.

columns.name: RATE_TABLE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the rate table.

columns.name: RATE_DIMENSION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the rate dimension.

columns.name: RATE_TABLE_VALUE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the rate table value.

columns.name: TIER_MINIMUM_AMOUNT
columns.description: Minimum amount of the rate dimension tier. If the dimension is of type expression, this column contains the evaluated amount at the time of the calculation.

columns.name: TIER_MAXIMUM_AMOUNT
columns.description: Maximum amount of the rate dimension tier. If the dimension is of type expression, this column contains the evaluated amount at the time of the calculation.

columns.name: TIER_RATE
columns.description: The commission result assigned to the dimension tier.

columns.name: TIER_SEQUENCE
columns.description: The number of the tier.

columns.name: INPUT_BASE_AMOUNT
columns.description: The input amount that has been used in previous dimension tiers.

columns.name: INPUT_AMOUNT
columns.description: The input amount received for the calculation before splitting.

columns.name: INPUT_USED_IN_TIER
columns.description: The split input amount used to calculate the output of the current tier.

columns.name: SPLIT_RATE
columns.description: The part of the blended rate coming from this tier.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
